Name: Passable Objects
Author: yakminepunyo
Description:
[b][size=3][What is this mod?]
[/size][/b][size=3]This mod adds a noclip function and a new console command (noclip) toggles it.

[b][How does this mod works?]
[/b]This mod patches game's default collision, so characters (incl. NPCs, Animals, Monsters, etc.) can pass through all objects.
Patching is a delicate thing, so it might contains Environment-dependent bugs.
I tested with Windows10 and SDV 1.3.15 and SMAPI 2.6-beta15
Also worked with 1.2 and SMAPI 2.5.5

[b][How to use noclip function?]
[/b]After installed this mod, type 'noclip' in the console, and you should be able to toggle noclip.

[/size][b][Where can I get source codes?]
[/b]You can see and download the codes from [url=https://github.com/pomepome/PassableObjects]GitHub[/url].
